title: 第131章 先浅浅地加个血
slug: 我在战锤抽词条帝皇站起来了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

卡班哈是恐虐大魔。

它们恐虐大魔不像那些奸奇的大魔，喜欢设陷阱，搞阴谋，在敌人背后捅刀子。

也不像纳垢的那些大魔，喜欢下毒，慢慢耗，慢慢磨，等敌人自己腐烂。

更不像色孽恶魔那种恶心的阴沟老鼠。提起色孽恶魔来，连其它的混沌大魔都看不起它们。

它是恐虐的大魔，是血神最宠爱的战将，为魔处世的信条只有一个，那就是正面冲过去，用斧头劈开一切挡路的东西。

所以当卡班哈的灵能感知扫过普兰迪姆，发现极限战士已经选好了应战的位置，它没有犹豫，也不玩虚的，就直接降落这个星球应战。

也不知道卡班哈是不是疯了，它直接从太空轨道把飞船砸了下去。

此事在卡迪亚的毁灭中亦有记载。

上一个做出这种事的人叫做阿巴蛋哥哥。

但是阿巴蛋哥哥也是把空飞船当炮弹用，而不是直接把自己坐的飞船当炮弹啊。

整艘恶魔飞船变成了一颗拖着暗红色尾焰的巨型火球，以巨型陨石的速度朝星球表面坠落。

巨型飞船燃烧着向地面撞下来。

技术军士们头盔目镜上传感器尖叫，数据流疯了似的往上跳。

一艘万吨级的飞船以每秒数公里的速度撞击行星表面，产生的能量是任何已知武器都无法比拟的。

卡尔加的吼声在通讯频道里炸开：“全员防护——！寻找掩体——！！！！”

命令不需要重复第二次。

极限战士们全部自动伏低身体，把盾牌举过头顶，或者寻找掩体。

头盔全部戴上，战甲密封。动力甲的护颈甲片自动弹起，遮住了头盔和胸甲之间的缝隙。

所有的防御工事和重型武器都自动进入了抗冲击模式，炮管锁死，底座固定。

十秒后，飞船撞上了地面，撞击点在距离极限战士的主阵地大约十二公里的一个平坦的大陆平原。

“咚——！！！”地一声。

响彻天际。

整颗星球都在颤抖，地面剧烈抖动，横向的震动波向四面八方传播。

中心点的空气被挤压成了一圈白色的高速膨胀环状云，边缘锋利得像刀刃，所过之处，地面上残余的那些沙土和岩石碎屑全部被卷起来，像子弹一样向四周飞射。

大地撕开裂缝，残留的岩石丘陵震得石块滚落，枯竭死寂的土地被重新搅动。

林恩看着感觉有点可惜。

早知道就提前在普兰迪姆上撒一些微生物菌种和土壤活化剂。

还能趁乱让卡班哈帮普兰迪姆翻翻地。

极限战士们蹲在战壕里，掩体和盾牌外面被飞射而来的沙石打得噼里啪啦作响。

即使有动力甲的减震系统他们依然感觉到了从脚底传上来的剧烈的震动，需要以手撑地才能稳住身体。

三连长也难以置信说出了那句话：“那个恶魔是不是疯了？”

这样的撞击下，飞船肯定是保不住了，飞船上的恶魔估计也得死一大部分。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Ka'banhar is the great daemon of Khorne.

Unlike the great demons of Tzeentch, they like to set traps, conspire, and stab their enemies in the back.

It's not like those big demons of Nurgle who like to poison, slowly consume and grind them, and wait for the enemy to rot.

Not like disgusting gutter rats like the demons of Slaanesh.When it comes to Daemons of Slaanesh, even other Chaos Daemons look down upon them.

It is the great demon of Khorne and the favorite warrior of the Blood God. It has only one creed in serving the demon, and that is to rush forward and use an ax to split everything in its way.

So when Kabanha's psychic perception swept across Plandim and found that the Ultramarines had already chosen a location to fight, it did not hesitate or play tricks, and landed directly on the planet to fight.

I don’t know if Kabanha is crazy, but it directly smashed the spacecraft from orbit.

This is also recorded in the Destruction of Cadia.

The last person to do such a thing was called Brother Abadan.

But Brother Abadan also used the empty spaceship as a cannonball, instead of directly using the spaceship he was riding in as a cannonball.

The entire demon spacecraft turned into a giant fireball with a dark red tail flame, falling towards the surface of the planet at the speed of a giant meteorite.

The giant spaceship burned and crashed to the ground.

The sensors on the Techmarines' helmet visors screamed, and the data stream jumped up like crazy.

A 10,000-ton spacecraft hits the planet's surface at a speed of several kilometers per second, generating energy unmatched by any known weapon.

Calga's roar exploded in the communication channel: "Full protection——! Find bunkers——!!!"

The command does not need to be repeated a second time.

The Ultramarines all automatically lowered their bodies, raised their shields above their heads, or looked for cover.

The helmets are all put on and the armor is sealed.The neck guard of the power armor automatically popped up, covering the gap between the helmet and breastplate.

All fortifications and heavy weapons automatically entered anti-impact mode, with barrels locked and bases fixed.

Ten seconds later, the spacecraft hit the ground. The impact point was on a flat continental plain about twelve kilometers away from the Ultramarines' main position.

"Boom——!!!" There was a sound.

resounded throughout the sky.

The entire planet was trembling, the ground shook violently, and horizontal shock waves spread in all directions.

The air at the center was squeezed into a white ring of high-speed expanding annular clouds, with edges as sharp as blades. Wherever it passed, the remaining sand and rock fragments on the ground were rolled up and flew around like bullets.

Cracks opened in the earth, the remaining rocky hills shook and stones rolled down, and the dry and dead land was stirred up again.

Linn felt a little pity looking at it.

If you had known better, you would have sprinkled some microbial strains and soil activator on Plantium in advance.

You can also take advantage of the chaos and ask Kabanha to help Plandim dig up the ground.

The Ultramarines were squatting in the trenches, and the outside of their bunkers and shields was crackling with flying sand and stones.

Even with the shock-absorbing system of the power armor, they still felt the violent vibrations coming from the soles of their feet, and they needed to hold their hands on the ground to stabilize their bodies.

The third company commander also said those words in disbelief: "Is that devil crazy?"

Under such an impact, the spacecraft will definitely not be saved, and most of the demons on the spacecraft will probably die.
